text:
zoe: Quick heads-up — the recorder didn't pick up the first slide. OBS shows 'encoder init failed'. I'm going to hold off the intro for ~6m while AV checks.
streaming-bot: Recording job error: encoder_init_failed. (automated)
theo: On my way to room C. @riley can you verify the HDMI patch to hw-enc-4?
riley: Checking now. Patch is loose, reseating HDMI cable.
amanda: If we need to reshuffle: can we move the live Q&A to the top and do the roadmap demo later? That would let us keep people engaged while we fix archive.
joanet: Captions service reports intermittent disconnects. Reconnecting attempts ongoing.
captions: Skyline reconnect attempt 1/5 — ETA ~4m.
streaming-bot: Spawning RTMP fallback to backup ingest.
theo: HDMI reseated. hw-enc-4 back online. Starting local OBS capture to make sure we have audio levels. Mic 3 low — boosting +3dB.
zoe: Thanks. Let's keep the planned order but shorten the roadmap to 7 minutes; push the poll to the end. If archive isn't available in 10m we'll mark deck as unrecorded and upload slides+narration later. Sound okay? :raising_hand:
amanda: Fine. I'll trim slides and prep a shortened narrative.
riley: Local OBS confirmed recording to node-c. Upload to S3 after meeting.
captions: Manual captioner standing by, will join in ~90s.
zoe: Nice. Action item: add encoder watchdog check and OBS auto-start verification to the postmortem/runbook. I'll send a 2-min start ping once archive is confirmed.
streaming-bot: Recording started on local-obs-node-c. Archive expected to be available in ~12m.
j anet: Updating agenda doc and noting poll move. Lars, can you condense the roadmap walkthrough to <7m?
lars: Yep — cutting deep-dive slide. Will do a 6-minute highlight.
zoe: Great — starting in 3m for a short intro then Q&A-first. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
thread_text_snippet: recorder didn't pick up the first slide. OBS shows 'encoder init failed'
